2. DRILL TEST READY: s4-assessment-drill-1

Targeted 12-question drill built from Assessment 2A misses. Ready to deploy.

FILE: motor-city-math/data/s4-assessment-drill-1.json
TITLE: S4 Rational Expressions: Gap Drill
TIME: 45 min
QUESTIONS: 12

Section A (Q1-Q5): Factor-first simplification — 5 questions
  Targets the Q13 conceptual gap (term-by-term cancellation). Every problem requires factoring GCF and/or difference of squares before canceling. Warnings embedded in question text.

Section B (Q6-Q9): LCD addition/subtraction — 4 questions
  Targets S4.b (0% on assessment). LCD with linear factors, monomial denominators, and sign distribution traps on subtraction.

Section C (Q10-Q12): Sign distribution / expansion — 3 questions
  Targets Q5/Q14 errors. Includes squared binomial expansion with leading coefficient and a difference quotient.

Weighted 5-4-3 toward factoring since it's the foundational gap — if Kai can't factor reliably, LCD work won't land.

To deploy: add to tests registry, wire exam URL as https://marcusash.github.io/motor-city-math/?exam=s4-assessment-drill-1, add to manifest if applicable.
